<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">

    <main id="game"></main>
    <script>
        // Simulated game logic
        const game = document.getElementById('game');
        game.innerHTML = 'Chess Battle Game';

<script>
    // Game state management
    let gameState = {
        player1: 'White',
        player2: 'Black',
        turn: 'Player1',
        board: [
            ['WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP'],
            ['BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP'],
            ['__', '__', '__', '__', '__', '__', '__'],
            ['__', '__', '__', '__', '__', '__', '__'],
            ['__', '__', '__', '__', '__', '__', '__'],
            ['WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP', 'WP'],
            ['BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP', 'BP']
        ],
        currentPlayer: 0,
        gameOver: false
    };

    // Game logic functions
    function updateBoard() {
        const board = gameState.board;
        const currentPlayer = gameState.currentPlayer;
        const currentPlayerColor = gameState.player1 === 'White' ? 'White' : 'Black';

        // Update board display
        const boardElement = document.getElementById('game');
        boardElement.innerHTML = '';

        for (let row = 0; row < 7; row++) {
            const rowElement = document.createElement('div');
            rowElement.style.display = 'flex';
            rowElement.style.flexWrap = 'wrap';
            rowElement.style.gap = '10px';
            rowElement.style.backgroundColor = row % 2 === 0 ? '#e0e0e0' : '#f0f0f0';

            for (let col = 0; col < 7; col++) {
                const piece = board[row][col];
                const pieceElement = document.createElement('div');
                pieceElement.style.width = '60px';
                pieceElement.style.height = '60px';
                pieceElement.style.display = 'flex';
                pieceElement.style.justifyContent = 'center';
                pieceElement.style.alignItems = 'center';
                pieceElement.style.border = '2px solid #000';
                pieceElement.style.backgroundColor = piece === 'WP' ? 'white' : 'black';
                pieceElement.style.color = piece === 'WP' ? 'black' : 'white';
                pieceElement.style.fontSize = '20px';
                pieceElement.style.textAlign = 'center';
                pieceElement.style.textTransform = 'uppercase';

                if (piece === '__') {
                    pieceElement.style.backgroundColor = '#ccc';
                }

                pieceElement.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (gameState.gameOver) return;
                    if (piece === '__') {
                        // Simulate a move
                        const newBoard = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(gameState.board));
                        newBoard[row][col] = currentPlayerColor;
                        gameState.board = newBoard;
                        gameState.currentPlayer = 1 - gameState.currentPlayer;
                        gameState.turn = gameState.currentPlayer === 0 ? 'Player2' : 'Player1';
                        updateBoard();
                    }
                });

                rowElement.appendChild(pieceElement);
            }

            boardElement.appendChild(rowElement);
        }
    }

    // Handle user input
    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target && event.target.classList.contains('piece')) {
            const piece = event.target;
            const row = Array.from(piece.parentElement).indexOf(piece);
            const col = Array.from(piece.parentElement.children).indexOf(piece);

            if (gameState.gameOver) return;

            // Check if the move is valid
            if (gameState.currentPlayer === 0 && gameState.player1 === 'White') {
                if (row === 0 || row === 6 || col === 0 || col === 6) {
                    // Invalid move, do nothing
                    return;
                }
            } else if (gameState.currentPlayer === 1 && gameState.player2 === 'Black') {
                if (row === 0 || row === 6 || col === 0 || col === 6) {
                    // Invalid move, do nothing
                    return;
                }
            }

            // Simulate a valid move
            const newBoard = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(gameState.board));
            newBoard[row][col] = gameState.currentPlayer === 0 ? 'White' : 'Black';
            gameState.board = newBoard;
            gameState.currentPlayer = 1 - gameState.currentPlayer;
            gameState.turn = gameState.currentPlayer === 0 ? 'Player2' : 'Player1';
            updateBoard();
        }
    });

    // Game progression
    function checkWinCondition() {
        const board = gameState.board;
        const currentPlayer = gameState.currentPlayer;
        const currentPlayerColor = currentPlayer === 0 ? 'White' : 'Black';

        // Check if player1 has won
        if (board[0][0] === 'White' && board[0][1] === 'White' && board[0][2] === 'White' &&
            board[0][3] === 'White' && board[0][4] === 'White' && board[0][5] === 'White' &&
            board[0][6] === 'White') {
            gameState.gameOver = true;
            gameState.result = 'Player1 wins!';
            return true;
        }

        // Check if player2 has won
        if (board[6][0] === 'Black' && board[6][1] === 'Black' && board[6][2] === 'Black' &&
            board[6][3] === 'Black' && board[6][4] === 'Black' && board[6][5] === 'Black' &&
            board[6][6] === 'Black') {
            gameState.gameOver = true;
            gameState.result = 'Player2 wins!';
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Game loop
    function gameLoop() {
        if (gameState.gameOver) {
            alert(gameState.result);
            return;
        }

        if (checkWinCondition()) {
            return;
        }

        // Check for draw
        const board = gameState.board;
        let draw = true;

        for (let row = 0; row < 7; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < 7; col++) {
                if (board[row][col] === '__') {
                    draw = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!draw) break;
        }

        if (draw) {
            gameState.gameOver = true;
            gameState.result = 'It\'s a draw!';
            return;
        }

        // Switch players
        gameState.currentPlayer = 1 - gameState.currentPlayer;
        gameState.turn = gameState.currentPlayer === 0 ? 'Player2' : 'Player1';
        updateBoard();
    }

    // Start the game
    updateBoard();
    setInterval(gameLoop, 1000);
</script>
